description: Window, event and lifecycle access only. The renderer reaches the daemon through this crate's own commands, and reaches media through the clipmill-media:// scheme this crate serves — a scheme that answers only files the daemon authorized, named by an artifact's own descriptor, for a project that published it. No plugin permission is granted here. The dialog plugin is registered so this crate's own choose_source_file command can open a native file picker; because no dialog: or fs: permission appears below, a page cannot invoke either, and the only path to a file dialog is a command that returns one user-chosen path. tauri-plugin-fs is in the dependency tree solely as the dialog plugin's own dependency, and the shell and HTTP plugins remain absent from Cargo.toml entirely.
